svg.title: Ground-truth contexts versus model-generated contexts in Commit Forcing
svg.desc: Teacher Forcing and Commit Forcing use matched history/state interfaces. CF constructs one generated history/state transition without gradients. Original committed latents update history; decoded committed motion determines boundary state. Continuation residual targets are rebased to the sampled code embedding while the ground-truth latent remains fixed. No recursive rollout or GT re-encoding is depicted.
